summary: First iteration: comprehensive testing of Seydişehir Sosyal Şehir app. Backend (FastAPI + MongoDB): 20/20 pytest tests PASSED (health, auth mock OTP, all 16 content endpoints, social flow create/like/comment). Frontend (Expo/React Native via web preview): all critical mobile flows working — welcome → register/login → SMS OTP 123456 → tabs (home/discover/feed/profile); category navigation for all 16 categories with detail pages (haber, firma, etkinlik, ilan) rendering correctly; feed like/comment counts visible and like toggles; new post creation persists and appears in feed; profile shows user info + posts grid. Zero console errors during E2E. Turkish mock data displays properly. No deprecated Expo packages found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event hooks ('startup'/'shutdown'); should migrate to lifespan context manager — not blocking but will warn in newer FastAPI versions.
Token in mock auth is just the user_id (no signing). Acceptable for MVP mock but should be replaced with JWT for production.
seed_data_creation: No additional seed required — backend auto-seeds 5 demo users + firmalar/haberler/etkinlikler/ilanlar/is-ilanlari/eczane/stories/posts on first startup. Created 2 ad-hoc test users (TEST_*) and 2 test posts (TEST_*) during testing via API/UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py — reuse with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env var. Frontend uses Expo Router with route groups (auth)/(tabs); tabs render with bottom nav (Ana Sayfa/Keşfet/Akış/Profil). Key testIDs: welcome-screen, welcome-{register,login}-btn, login-phone-input, login-submit-btn, register-{fullname,username,phone}-input, register-submit-btn, otp-input, otp-verify-btn, home-screen, discover-screen, feed-screen, profile-screen, category-{slug}, haber-{id}, firma-{id}, etkinlik-{id}, ilan-{id}, *-detail, new-post-screen, post-text-input, post-submit-btn. Mock OTP is always 123456.
